instruction: Access the manage reservations page on the United Airlines website.

metadata.explanation: This variation asks the agent to navigate to the manage reservations page on United Airlines website. Similar to the original task (baggage fee calculator), this is a simple navigation task to access a core airline service page. The evaluator checks if the active tab URL matches the pattern 'united.com/en/us/manage-reservation'. No custom functions needed as we reuse the existing is_expected_url_pattern_match metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement: accessing the manage reservations page on United Airlines website
Getter (get_active_tab_info) properly extracts the active tab URL from accessibility tree and returns page info including URL
Metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match) correctly handles the result dict with 'url' field and performs pattern matching
Pattern 'united.com/en/us/manage-reservation' semantically matches the instruction requirement for the manage reservations page
Data flow is correct: getter extracts URL -> metric performs regex search on URL -> returns 1.0 if pattern found
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Pattern could be more flexible to handle URL variations (e.g., '/manage-reservations' with 's', different locale paths like '/en-us/')
Consider using URL normalization to handle protocol variations (http/https), www prefix variations, and trailing slashes
Pattern as plain string works with re.search() as substring match, but could be more robust as proper regex with anchors or alternatives
